messages.author: 03260d6b59ce9a07
messages.subject: Error during WebSocket handshake: Sec-WebSocket-Accept mismatch
parts:
Dear All,

I have a problem with running the examples. Hopefully you can help me. 
I run:

> library(shiny)
> runExample("01_hello")

Opening the web developer tools I can see there is a box (rectangle) calles "shiny-plot-output", but this is empty. 
Opening this console it shows:
WebSocket connection to 'ws://amur1.iiasa.ac.at:8100/' failed: Error during WebSocket handshake: Sec-WebSocket-Accept mismatch

At the browser window: the slider is shown, but not the result.
Any help how-to fix this problem would be great.
Environment is R 3.0.1 with shiny 0.6.0 on Solaris 10.


Kind regards 
Hans

--
